rounds.response:
Looking at my holding:  
- Q♠ 10♥ – offsuit broadway, decent but not premium.  
- I have position (I’m the BB and act second post-flop) and I’m up against a single pre-flop raiser who has only called 10 more chips so far.  
- Pot is 30 and a standard 3-bet from the big blind vs SB call would be around 3 × the current bet (≈ 60–70), risking about 50 more chips. That’s comfortably within my 990 stack.

I’ll apply pressure now rather than let a single opponent see the flop cheaply with who-knows-what.

[Bet 70]
